objective: Generate exactly one 16:9 composite studio image with three conspicuously different views of the exact same unbranded hiking shoe: left side profile, center top view, and right rear view.

canonical_prop_design.identity: One adult low-top hiking shoe with a rounded toe, padded collar, dark rubber outsole, and rust-orange upper; the same left shoe in every cell.
canonical_prop_design.construction: Six pairs of black metal eyelets with black round laces, gray reinforced toe cap, stitched side overlay shaped as one long curved strip, padded heel, and thick black lug sole.
canonical_prop_design.color_and_materials: Rust-orange matte woven fabric upper; charcoal gray synthetic toe cap and heel panel; black laces, eyelets, and lug sole; clean unworn condition.
canonical_prop_design.markings_and_asymmetry: No logo, branding, words, or pattern. Each view is of the same left shoe; handedness never flips.

canvas_and_layout.composite_rule: All three views appear together on one image canvas; never separate images or files.
canvas_and_layout.grid: One horizontal row of three equal cells with thin solid #d1d1d2 vertical separators.
canvas_and_layout.framing: One complete uncropped shoe centered in each cell with generous margins; full-object views have comparable scale, while the top view shows the complete shoe from directly overhead.
canvas_and_layout.labels: No captions, view names, orientation labels, or overlaid text.

views.visible_surfaces_and_details: Entire shoe pointing toe toward viewer-left, showing the long rust-orange side, curved charcoal overlay, black sole profile, and heel. This silhouette must be unmistakably horizontal.
Same left shoe from directly above, toe toward bottom of frame, showing six pairs of eyelets, black laces, gray toe cap, and padded collar opening.
Same left shoe viewed from behind, showing the charcoal heel panel, padded collar, and black lug sole width; no toe visible.

background_and_lighting.background: Uniform solid #504f50 studio backdrop in every cell.
background_and_lighting.light: Broad soft neutral product light with controlled highlights and subtle contact shadows.

camera_and_optics: Orthographic side profile, exact overhead top, and orthographic rear; deep sharp focus. Each panel has a clearly different camera angle.
material_detail: Woven rust-orange fabric, stitched curved side overlay, gray synthetic cap and heel reinforcement, black laces, metal eyelets, and black tread, all consistent between cells.
consistency_locks: Exactly one 16:9 landscape output image contains three cells in one row with thin solid #d1d1d2 separators and uniform solid #504f50 backgrounds.
All three panels show the identical left shoe, without changing sole, upper, color, laces, eyelets, overlays, or condition.
The views must be visibly distinct: horizontal left side, overhead top, straight rear; not three repeated three-quarter or side views.
negative_prompt: alternate shoes or product variants, extra parts, logos, text
separate images, portrait canvas, cropped product, inconsistent scale, overlapping cells
hands, people, lifestyle environment, orientation labels, watermarks
dramatic shadows, shallow focus, motion blur, wide-angle distortion
three similar orientations, duplicate side views, same view repeated
final_generation_instruction: ONE single 16:9 landscape composite image, not three images: three side-by-side cells with thin solid #d1d1d2 vertical separators and uniform flat #504f50 background. Show the SAME rust-orange left hiking shoe from three clearly distinct angles: LEFT CELL strict horizontal side profile, CENTER CELL direct overhead top view, RIGHT CELL straight rear heel view. Entire shoe uncropped in each cell; no words or labels.
